content.text:
Here is where those pieces actually live under `AXEL/axel_project/combat`. Use these **absolute paths** (your repo root is `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot`).

---

## 1) Numeric / mirrored shell (v1) — `SPINS` | grid | `ITEMS`

**Scene entry (also used by default `combat_test.tscn`, which only extends the v1 script):**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_v1.tscn`
- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn` (same script as v1)

**Script (all side rectangles + bottom bar are created here, not in the `.tscn`):**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test_v1.gd`  
  (and `combat_test.gd` only `extends` this file)

| Target | Node / variable | What to change |
|--------|------------------|----------------|
| **Left rectangle (spin history)** | Runtime `PanelContainer` stored in `_spin_history_panel`; built in `_build_spin_history_placeholder()` → `_make_side_panel_vertical("SPINS")`. Added under `PlayRow` as first child. | **Fonts:** per-letter labels use `add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)` and color in `_make_side_panel_vertical()`; placeholder row labels use 12 in `_build_spin_history_placeholder()`. **Panel frame:** `_side_panel_style()` (`bg_color`, `border_color`, `set_border_width_all(2)`, margins). **Row chips:** `StyleBoxFlat` on each `PanelContainer` row in `_build_spin_history_placeholder()` (bg/border 1px). |
| **Right rectangle (items)** | Runtime `PanelContainer` named **`ItemPickerPanel`**, from `_build_item_picker()` → `_make_side_panel("ITEMS")`. | **Fonts:** header via `_make_side_panel()` (14) and again in `_build_item_picker()` on `_item_picker_title` (14); checkboxes 13; empty label 12. **Panel frame:** same `_side_panel_style()`. |
| **Bottom premium / meter progress bar** | `ProgressBar` **`PremiumProgressBar`** (`_premium_progress`), created in `_build_play_shell()`. | **Fill/background (no outline today):** `pb_bg` and `pb_fill` are `StyleBoxFlat` with only `bg_color` set. Add thin red border on `pb_bg` (and/or `pb_fill`) with `border_color` + `set_border_width_*`. **Height constant:** `PREMIUM_BAR_HEIGHT` (10.0). **Position/size:** `_layout_premium_bar()`; grid vertical space: `combat.fit_to_panel(host_size, PREMIUM_BAR_HEIGHT + 2.0)` in `_layout_combat()`. |

**Turning “SPINS” into a single horizontal title, top-centered**

- Today the title is **one `Label` per character** in a vertical `VBoxContainer` (`letter_col`) inside `_make_side_panel_vertical()` in `combat_test_v1.gd`.  
- To get a **single horizontal centered title**, replace that block with something like one top `Label` (`label_text` as full string, `horizontal_alignment = CENTER`) plus the scroll/list below, and adjust the outer container (e.g. `VBoxContainer` instead of `HBoxContainer` + vertical letters).

**Corner HUD boxes (not left/right columns, but rectangle + fonts in v1’s alternate top layout):** legacy/top nodes in `combat_test_v1.tscn` include `TopCenterInfo` / `BankrollLabel`, `GoalLabel`, `SeedLabel`, etc. Font **36** for bankroll is applied in code: `_apply_responsive_layout()` → `bankroll_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 36)`.

---

## 2) Chip-bar shell (v2) — `MATCHED` | grid | `ITEMS`

**Scene:**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_v2.tscn` — fonts on **`MultiplierReadout`** (`theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 32`), **`SpinButton`** (22 + spin `StyleBoxFlat` sub-resources), overlays similar to v1. Side columns are **not** declared here; they are built in code.

**Script:**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_test_v2.gd`

| Target | Node / variable | What to change |
|--------|------------------|----------------|
| **Outer combat frame** | `PanelContainer` **`CombatFrame`** (`_combat_frame`), style in `_build_combat_frame()` (`frame_style` `StyleBoxFlat`: 4px border, radii, margins). | Adjust `StyleBoxFlat` fields on `frame_style` for the big rectangle look. |
| **Left (`MATCHED`) / right (`ITEMS`) rectangles** | `_matched_panel`, `_items_panel` from `_make_side_panel()`; headers `_matched_header`, `_items_header` (meta keys `"header"`). | **Panel:** local `style` `StyleBoxFlat` in `_make_side_panel()` (1px border, corners 6, margins 6). **Header font:** `header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)` — this is the main “small” text to bump for side panels. **`_refresh_items_panel()`** updates `_items_header.text`. On narrow viewports, `_apply_responsive_layout()` toggles header visibility. |
| **Tiles inside panels** | `MatchedLogTile` (`matched_log_tile.gd`): **`TILE_SIZE`** `Vector2(36, 36)` and panel `StyleBoxFlat` in `_ready()`. | Scaling tiles = constant + borderStyle in that script. |
| **Bottom progress bar** | **`PremiumProgressBar`** (`_premium_progress`) in `_build_combat_frame()` — `pb_style` (background), `pb_fill`; **height 8.0** set in `_layout_combat()`. | Add red outline on `pb_style` / `pb_fill` like v1; optionally extract height to a `const` for clarity. |

There is **no separate “spin history” column** in v2; the left log is **`MATCHED`** (`_on_matched_symbols_resolved` fills `_matched_list`).

---

## 3) Core combat scene (grid / readouts inside `CombatRoot`)

**Scene:**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\combat_root.tscn`

**Notable nodes (fonts / red outlines):**

- **`GridFrame`** (`ReferenceRect`) — `border_color`, `border_width` (grid outline).
- **`MultiplierLabel`** — `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 18`.
- **`WinningsOverlayLabel`**, **`RoundWinningsLabel`**, **`EncounterWonLabel`** — font sizes and outline overrides in the scene; theme `res://combat/ui/terminal_theme.tres`.

**Script-driven label styling (when you need functions, not `.tscn`):**

- `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scripts\combat_root.gd` — multiple `add_theme_font_size_override` / outline color tweaks (e.g. around winnings overlay and dynamic labels ~1898+ in grep results).

---

## 4) Quick mapping to your three edits

1. **Bigger fonts in left/right rectangles**  
   - **v1:** `combat_test_v1.gd` — `_make_side_panel_vertical`, `_build_spin_history_placeholder`, `_make_side_panel`, `_build_item_picker`.  
   - **v2:** `combat_test_v2.gd` — `_make_side_panel` (header size 10), plus `matched_log_tile.gd` if you want larger tiles.

2. **Spin history title horizontal, top center**  
   - **v1 only:** `combat_test_v1.gd` — function **`_make_side_panel_vertical()`** (replace vertical letter stack with one top `Label`).  
   - **v2:** headers are already single-line centered in `_make_side_panel()`; to move “to top center” of the **whole combat UI** you would change parent layout (e.g. `frame_vbox` in `_build_combat_frame`) or anchor a dedicated title — that is separate from the side panel header today.

3. **Thin red outline on bottom progress bar**  
   - **v1:** `combat_test_v1.gd` — **`_build_play_shell()`** (`pb_bg` / `pb_fill`).  
   - **v2:** `combat_test_v2.gd` — **`_build_combat_frame()`** (`pb_style` / `pb_fill`).

---

**Note:** `C:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\goal_hud.tscn` defines `GoalLabel` / `BudgetLabel` but is **not referenced** under `combat` by name search; the live goal/spin HUD for these test scenes is mostly the nodes and script above.

If you tell me whether you care about **v1, v2, or both**, the exact line-level edit list can be narrowed to one shell only.
